description_html:
Wacom ACK42213 Paper Clip


Wacom Paper Clip upgrades your Wacom Intuos Pro (PTH-660, PTH-860). It holds up to ten A5 (half-letter sized) or A4 (letter sized) paper sheets to your tablet, ready to sketch on with the optional Finetip Pen or Ballpoint Pen. An accessory Soft Case is included to safely store and transport your Paper Clip, pens and other accessories.

 

Compatible with

  • Wacom Intuos Pro (PTH660, PTH660P, PTH860, PTH860P)

What's included

  • Paper clip
  • Accessory Soft Case

description_html_ar:
Wacom ACK42213 Paper Clip



 Wacom Paper Clip تستوعب ما يصل إلى عشر أوراق ورقية A5 أو A4، وهي جاهزة للرسم عليها باستخدام قلم Finetip Pen أو Ballpoint Pen الاختياري، كما انه مزود بحافظة لنقل مشبك الورق والأقلام وغيرها من الملحقات بأمان.
